question:
I have a repository with DBT Models. One of my models has the below .yml file

version: 2
models:
  - name: my_employees
    tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns:
            - employee_id
            - dept_id

I am using the dbt-checkpoint pre-commit hook for the data quality of the DBT Project.

Here's a part of .pre-commit-config.yaml:

default_language_version:
  python: python3.10
repos:
:
- repo: https://github.com/dbt-checkpoint/dbt-checkpoint
  rev: v2.0.6
  hooks:
  - id: check-model-has-tests-by-group
    args: [--manifest, "dbt/target/manifest.json", "--tests", "unique", "not_null", "dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns", "--test-cnt", "1", "--"]
:

All my pre-commit hooks are working fine. This one throws an exception even though I have the dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns test on the model.

my_employees: has only 0 test(s) from ['unique', 'not_null', 'dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns']

Is this a known error?
title: Failures in the dbt-checkpoint check-model-has-tests-by-group even when dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns is present
answer:
I had the same bug. If you remove dbt_utils. it works for me:

default_language_version:
  python: python3.10
repos:
:
- repo: https://github.com/dbt-checkpoint/dbt-checkpoint
  rev: v2.0.6
  hooks:
  - id: check-model-has-tests-by-group
    args: [--manifest, "dbt/target/manifest.json", "--tests", "unique", "not_null", "unique_combination_of_columns", "--test-cnt", "1", "--"]
:
